title: Cleanup finishes cleanly: mark the run cleaned, retry after a half-done cleanup, steady merge state

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S63 relay later notes and owner decisions of 2026-10-23. (1) After a successful run.cleanup the run record is untouched (internal/daemon/landed.go ~147-156): the row stays merged and keeps offering the cleanup key, and after the next HEAD change its merge state is unknown, so retention never prunes it. Owner: mark the record cleaned and hide it from Ready. (2) If git branch -d fails after git worktree remove succeeded, a retry fails at worktree remove. Owner: skip worktree remove when the worktree is already gone. (3) The merge check clears each run's merged flag at the start of a pass (landed.go ~82), so snapshots show merge state unknown and cleanup is refused while git runs; keep the previous value until the write-back. (4) landed_test.go writes d.runs.merged without the lock (~384) and blockedGit sets GitBin on a live cache (~292): make the tests lock-safe. (5) The help footnote is now under '+2 more lines' in the action-help goldens; help has no scrolling (a help-layout item, noted only).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/daemon/landed.go`: after a successful cleanup set the run record cleaned; make cleanup idempotent (if the worktree path is gone, skip `git worktree remove` and run `git branch -d`); keep the previous merged value while a pass runs.
- `internal/runrec/record.go` and `docs/state.md`: a cleaned field on the run record (handle run.json versioning as state.md:144-146 says).
- `internal/tui/overview.go`: Ready hides a cleaned run.
- `internal/daemon/landed_test.go`: lock-safe tests and the new cases.
- `docs/dashboard.md` and `docs/state.md`: the cleaned state; retention prunes a cleaned, finished run.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestCleanupMarksTheRunCleaned: after a successful run.cleanup the record is cleaned, Ready hides it, and a second cleanup is refused with a reason.
- TestCleanupRetryAfterHalfDone: worktree remove succeeded and branch -d failed; a second cleanup skips worktree remove and runs branch -d (fake git).
- TestMergedValueSurvivesAPass: while a merge check runs, a snapshot still shows the previous merged value; cleanup is not refused for a run whose value is known.
- TestPruneRemovesACleanedFinishedRunBeyondTheKeepLimit.
- Golden views if the Ready list changes.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Write the failing tests first. 2. Add the cleaned field and its versioning. 3. Make cleanup idempotent and mark the record. 4. Keep the previous merged value until write-back. 5. Fix the two fragile tests. 6. Update docs. This touches the Ready list in the UI, so it gets the UI pass (r14, rule u10).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/daemon ./internal/runrec ./internal/tui
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
- adj lint
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner presses the cleanup key on a merged slice branch, answers y, and finds the worktree and branch gone and the row hidden.
